name: register_object_message_mapping

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_RegisterObjectMessageMapping consumes two values and stores them with the Script-bound object in one of eight 24-byte records immediately preceding the current object-message code

notes: ScriptCommand_RegisterObjectMessageMapping selects a free record or the existing record for the same Script-bound object, then stores the two stack values at record offsets 0x08 and 0x10. The eight-record table ends immediately before D_00388924, which command 455 get_object_message_code returns after the object-message dispatcher starts entry 9. This establishes the table as per-object message mapping state; the exact interpretation of the second mapped value remains unresolved. The JP corpus contains 352 calls, all in object-message entry logic.
